# Opex Tracking €0.6M Below Budget; Forecast Underspend €0.6M

- **Opex actuals €18.1M vs budget €18.5M YTD** (€0.4M favourable); full-year forecast €24.7M vs budget €25.3M saves €0.6M [frame query, canvas KPI opex].
- **Driver: lower IT & admin spend** in Agency Overheads (€11.0M YTD) and IT/TMS Platform (€3.2M YTD) [GL actuals]; phasing discipline across Sales & Customer Service (€3.9M YTD) [GL actuals].
- **Action: maintain cost discipline** through Q4 to protect EBITDA forecast €17.1M (5.9% margin) vs budget €18.1M (6.2%) [canvas KPI ebitda]; monitor headcount and discretionary spend monthly.

f_mvr4oj7o01vg6.sql:
SELECT VERSION_ID AS V, PERIOD AS K,
  SUM(IFF(MODULE = 'revenue', AMOUNT, 0)) AS REV, SUM(IFF(MODULE = 'cogs', AMOUNT, 0)) AS COGS,
  SUM(IFF(MODULE = 'opex', AMOUNT, 0)) AS OPEX, SUM(IFF(MODULE = 'da', AMOUNT, 0)) AS DA,
  COUNT_IF(AMOUNT IS NULL) AS MASKED
FROM SDP_HEPPNER.CANVAS.SV_PLAN WHERE FISCAL_YEAR = 2026 AND VERSION_ID IN (1,2,3) AND MODULE IN ('revenue','cogs','opex','da') GROUP BY 1, 2;
SELECT VERSION_ID AS V, PERIOD AS K, SUM(SHIPMENTS) AS SHIP FROM SDP_HEPPNER.CANVAS.SV_OPS WHERE FISCAL_YEAR = 2026 AND VERSION_ID IN (1,2,3) GROUP BY 1, 2;
-- ML band: SDP_HEPPNER.CANVAS.SV_FORECAST P10/P50/P90 ÷ FC shipments for 2026-10, 2026-11, 2026-12

SELECT ENTITY AS K, 'Q' || CEIL(TO_NUMBER(RIGHT(PERIOD, 2)) / 3) AS Q, VERSION_ID AS V,
  SUM(IFF(MODULE = 'revenue', AMOUNT, 0)) AS REV, SUM(IFF(MODULE = 'cogs', AMOUNT, 0)) AS COGS,
  SUM(IFF(MODULE = 'opex', AMOUNT, 0)) AS OPEX, SUM(IFF(MODULE = 'da', AMOUNT, 0)) AS DA, COUNT_IF(AMOUNT IS NULL) AS MASKED
